title: Multiply the published row-ledger terms
body:
## Summary
- The family charges are `9909 = 367 · 27`, `252 = 9 · 28` and `1024 = 2 · 512`. With `B = 2642` the ledger is `2 · 2642 + 9909 + 252 + 1024 = 16469`, and the three external terms sum to 11,185.
- The BIT row is `2 · (64² + 1) + 9909 + 252 = 18355`. The degree gap is `10^6 − (51/25) · 20161 = 23971789/25`.
- The displayed caps `4362.14` and `12556.14` differ by exactly 8194. Their guards are 16 and 17, and both caps sit below `6,562,783`. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
